title: Iran seeking to expand attacks in UK to military sites, MI5 chief warns
summary_full: Iran is reportedly increasing its focus on military targets in Britain, including RAF Fairford. The suspected plot against the air base has prompted significant security responses and investigations. British authorities believe the incident may have links to Iran's Revolutionary Guard. Additionally, MI5 chief Ken McCallum highlighted broader trends in Iran's threat activities this year. The rise of state threats and the potential misuse of artificial intelligence were also addressed.
